title: Sailboat Sailing on Water, 1940s B&W Snapshot, July 1947
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot featuring a single sailboat with sails fully hoisted gliding across open water. In the far horizon, a low-lying island or distant shoreline is visible beneath a hazy sky. The physical print has a classic deckled scalloped border, typical of amateur photography prints from the post-WWII era.
